text:
anna: Rolling forward plan to make /v2 the default route for text.generate on hosted API. Change window Tue 2026-03-24 22:00-00:00 PT. Initial traffic split: 10% v2 / 90% v1 for 30m -> 50/50 for 30m -> 100% after verification. Will use sticky routing for persistent clients (30m). Please confirm no clients hardcode behavior based on absence of X-API-Version header.

kevin: Rollback criteria?

sre_oncall: Rollback/trip triggers: 1) 5xx rate > 2% above baseline for 5m; 2) median latency (p50) regresses > 150ms for 5m; 3) client error spike in mobile-web. If any fire, deploy-bot will auto-schedule rollback and page SRE.

mike: SDK question — we planned 6 months of v1 compatibility. Do we need a deprecation header to avoid surprises?

anna: Yes — we'll add response header "X-API-Deprecated: v1" and include notes in release docs and partner emails. Also adding an opt-in header for quick routing: "X-Opt-In: v2".

jess: I'll update release notes + changelog and ping partner success for the top 10 accounts.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: group alpha (3 instances) -> route weight=10%. Loading model bundles on gpu-pool-03. Monitor: https://console.redwood/release/1994550000 :construction_worker: 

kevin: Safety ask — honor explicit client pins. If a client sends "X-API-Version: v1" they should remain on v1 regardless of weight.

anna: Affirm. Explicit header pins will be honored. Also adding a temporary query param as a last-resort pin: ?api_version=v1. Update the quick smoke test below.

anna: Quick smoke curl (example):
```
curl -H 'X-API-Version: v2' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":5}' https://api.redwood.com/v2/text.generate
```

mike: SDK integration tests running now, will report in ~15m.

sre_oncall: Prepping rollback job: `deploy-bot rollback --to v1 --reason "auto-trigger"` if alerts fire; runbook updated (link on console).

jess: I'll add migration snippet for customers and a compatibility FAQ in the docs.

anna: Final checklist before go: docs updated, deploy-bot runbook attached, monitoring alerts set, customer comms drafted. Deploy in 3 hours unless there are blockers. :rocket:
